row: 濱海堤壩橫跨新加坡濱海水道，長 350 公尺，2008 年 10 月 31 日啟用，把濱海灣變成新加坡第 15 座水庫，兼具供水、防洪與休閒功能。

airspace.zh: 在新加坡飛行無人機須依民航局（CAAS）規定，市區與機場周邊多須事先申請許可；濱海灣一帶鄰近市中心與機場航道；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Drones in Singapore fall under CAAS rules; most of the city and the airport surroundings need a permit; Marina Bay lies close to the city centre and flight paths. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

barrage.note: the barrage across the Marina Channel

pump.note: the pump house with its grassed roof

channel.note: the channel between the bay and the barrage

mbs.note: Marina Bay and the city skyline

sea.note: the sea side of the barrage

tagline.zh-Hant: 把海灣變成城市中心的水庫
tagline.en: Turning a bay into a reservoir in the heart of the city

zh: 新加坡濱海灣的出海口，
一道 350 公尺長的堤壩橫跨濱海水道。
en: At the mouth of Marina Bay in Singapore,
a barrage 350 m long spans the Marina Channel.

zh: 它是濱海堤壩，2008 年 10 月 31 日啟用，
把海灣變成新加坡的第 15 座水庫。
en: This is the Marina Barrage, opened on 31 October 2008,
which turned the bay into Singapore's 15th reservoir.

zh: 堤壩內側是濱海蓄水池，水面約 240 公頃，
外側則是新加坡海峽。
en: Inside lies Marina Reservoir, about 240 hectares of water;
outside is the Singapore Strait.

zh: 集水區約 1 萬公頃，約占新加坡國土的六分之一，
包括市中心大部分的雨水。
en: Its catchment covers about 10,000 hectares, around a sixth of Singapore,
including most of the rain that falls on the city centre.

zh: 堤壩上有一排閘門與閘墩，
大雨又遇上退潮時，降下閘門把多餘的水放出海。
en: The barrage carries a row of gates between piers;
in heavy rain at low tide the gates are lowered to let surplus water out to sea.

zh: 西端的抽水站裡有大型抽水機，
漲潮時閘門無法放水，就改用抽水機排水。
en: At the west end the pump house holds giant pumps;
at high tide, when the gates cannot drain, the pumps take over.

zh: 抽水站的屋頂是一大片草坪，
民眾可以上去野餐、放風箏。
en: The roof of the pump house is a huge lawn,
where people come to picnic and fly kites.

zh: 堤壩旁邊是濱海灣花園，
水道兩岸成為城市的休閒水岸。
en: Beside the barrage are the Gardens by the Bay,
and both banks of the channel have become a waterfront for the city.

zh: 從海峽這一側飛向堤壩與市中心。
堤壩擋住海水，讓內側保持淡水。
en: Flying from the strait toward the barrage and the city centre.
The barrage keeps the sea out, so the water inside stays fresh.

zh: 一座設施同時負責供水、防洪與休閒，
是新加坡水資源管理的代表作。
en: One structure handles water supply, flood control and leisure,
a showcase of Singapore's water management.

zh: 接下來三部影片，看它的結構、施工與影響。
閘墩與閘門的尺寸為依公開資料的估計。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The next three films look at its structure, its construction and its impact.
The sizes of the piers and gates are estimates from public data.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 閘門、抽水機與潮汐的分工
tagline.en: How gates, pumps and the tides share the work

zh: 濱海堤壩是一座「擋潮閘」：
橫跨海灣出口，把內外的水分開。
en: The Marina Barrage is a tidal barrier:
it spans the mouth of the bay and separates the water inside from the sea.

zh: 閘墩之間裝著鋼製閘門，
平時立起擋住海水，需要放水時才降下。
en: Steel gates sit between the piers;
normally they stand up to keep the sea out, and are lowered only to release water.

zh: 閘門降下時，水從閘頂溢流出海，
這種方式要配合退潮，海面較低時才能排水。
en: When a gate is lowered, water spills over its top and out to sea;
this only works at low tide, when the sea is lower.

zh: 漲潮時海面比水庫高，閘門無法排水，
抽水站的大型抽水機就把水抽出海。
en: At high tide the sea is higher than the reservoir and the gates cannot drain;
then the giant pumps in the pump house push the water out.

zh: 從上方看，閘墩等距排列，
上方的橋面連接兩岸，也是人行步道。
en: From above the piers stand evenly spaced,
and the deck on top links the two shores as a walkway.

zh: 抽水站的屋頂種滿草，
能隔熱降溫，也讓建築融入水岸景觀。
en: The pump house roof is planted with grass,
keeping the building cool and blending it into the waterfront.

zh: 園區也設有太陽能板，
為設施提供一部分電力。
en: The site also has a solar park
that supplies part of the power the facility needs.

zh: 水庫內側的水位保持穩定，
平靜的水面適合划船與各種水上活動。
en: On the reservoir side the water level is kept steady,
and the calm water suits boating and other water sports.

zh: 擋潮、排洪、蓄水，
三種功能由閘門、抽水機與水庫分工合作。
en: Holding back the tide, draining floods and storing water:
the gates, the pumps and the reservoir share the work.

zh: 閘門、抽水站與綠屋頂，
是濱海堤壩結構的重點。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: Gates, a pump house and a green roof
are the key parts of the Marina Barrage.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從 1987 年的構想到 2008 年啟用
tagline.en: From an idea in 1987 to the opening in 2008

zh: 1987 年，李光耀提出構想：
在濱海灣出口築壩，把海灣變成水庫。
en: In 1987 Lee Kuan Yew put forward the idea
of damming the mouth of Marina Bay to turn it into a reservoir.

zh: 這個構想要等到將近二十年後，
才真正動工實現。
en: The idea would wait nearly twenty years
before work actually began.

zh: 2005 年 3 月 22 日，堤壩工程開工。
閘墩從海底基礎一座座立起。
en: Work on the barrage began on 22 March 2005.
The piers rose one by one from foundations on the sea bed.

zh: 西端同時興建抽水站，
安裝大型抽水機與控制設備。
en: At the west end the pump house went up at the same time,
with its giant pumps and control equipment.

zh: 閘門與橋面陸續完成，
堤壩把海灣與大海隔開。
en: The gates and the deck were completed in turn,
closing the bay off from the sea.

zh: 2008 年 10 月 31 日，濱海堤壩啟用，
成為新加坡的第 15 座水庫。
en: On 31 October 2008 the Marina Barrage opened
and became Singapore's 15th reservoir.

zh: 堤壩工程本身約 2.26 億新元，
屬於總額約 30 億新元的整體計畫。
en: The barrage itself cost about S$226 million,
part of a wider programme of about S$3 billion.

zh: 封閉之後，雨水不斷流入，
海灣裡的水逐漸由鹹轉淡。
en: Once closed, the bay kept receiving rain
and its water gradually turned from salt to fresh.

zh: 周邊的濱海灣花園等水岸計畫，
也在之後陸續完成。
en: Waterfront projects around it, such as the Gardens by the Bay,
were completed in the years that followed.

zh: 施工畫面為示意，
實際工程在海上分階段進行。
en: The construction scenes are illustrative;
the real work was carried out at sea in stages.

zh: 從構想到啟用，花了二十一年；
工程本身約三年半。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: From the idea to the opening took twenty-one years;
the building work itself about three and a half.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 供水、防洪，以及新的城市水岸
tagline.en: Water supply, flood control and a new city waterfront

zh: 新加坡土地狹小，天然水源有限，
把城市的雨水收集起來，是重要的對策。
en: Singapore is small and has few natural sources of water;
collecting the rain that falls on the city is a key answer.

zh: 濱海蓄水池收集市中心的雨水，
讓都市本身也成為水源的一部分。
en: Marina Reservoir gathers the rain from the city centre,
so the city itself becomes part of the water supply.

zh: 防洪方面，閘門與抽水機配合潮汐運作，
減輕市區低窪地帶淹水的情況。
en: For flood control, the gates and pumps work with the tides
to reduce flooding in the low-lying parts of the city.

zh: 水位穩定，不受潮汐影響，
水庫成為划船、龍舟與獨木舟的場地。
en: With a steady level, free of the tides,
the reservoir has become a place for rowing, dragon boats and kayaks.

zh: 綠屋頂成為熱門的休閒空間，
假日常見野餐與放風箏的人潮。
en: The green roof has become a popular place to relax,
busy at weekends with picnics and kites.

zh: 抽水站內也設有展覽空間，
介紹新加坡的水資源與永續發展。
en: Inside the pump house an exhibition space
explains Singapore's water and its plans for sustainability.

zh: 堤壩、花園與濱海灣，
組成新加坡最受歡迎的水岸景觀之一。
en: The barrage, the gardens and Marina Bay
together make one of Singapore's best-loved waterfronts.

zh: 面對海平面上升的長期挑戰，
這類擋潮與排水設施的角色會越來越重要。
en: With sea levels rising over the long term,
barriers and drainage works like this will matter more and more.

zh: 一道 350 公尺的堤壩，
改變了一座城市取水與防洪的方式。
en: One barrage 350 m long
changed how a whole city gets its water and keeps out floods.

zh: 濱海堤壩的四部影片到此結束。
歡迎到「AERO 無人機模擬飛行」親自飛一趟。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: This ends the four films on the Marina Barrage.
Come and fly here yourself in the AERO drone flight simulator.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

banner.zh: 電腦擬真重建・結構為簡化模型・非實地空拍
banner.en: Computer reconstruction · simplified structures · not drone footage
